pairs: Jehoiada having been strengthened, he took the centurions,
namely, Azariah, the son of Jeroham,
and Ishmael, the son of Jehohanan,
and also Azariah, the son of Obed,
and Maaseiah, the son of Adaiah,
and Elishaphat, the son of Zichri,
and he formed a pact with them.
congregaverunt Levitas de cunctis urbibus Juda,
they gathered together the Levites from all of the cities of Judah,
and the leaders of the families of Israel,
Iniit ergo omnis multitudo pactum in domo Dei cum rege,
Then the entire multitude formed a pact with the king, in the house of God.
the son of the king shall reign,
sicut locutus est Dominus super filios David.
just as the Lord has said concerning the sons of David.
Iste est ergo sermo quem facietis:
Therefore, this is the word that you shall do:
tertia pars vestrum qui veniunt ad sabbatum, sacerdotum,
One third part of you who arrive on the Sabbath,
and porters, shall be at the gates. Truly,
tertia vero pars ad domum regis:
one third part shall be at the house of the king.
et tertia ad portam quæ appellatur Fundamenti:
And one third shall be at the gate which is called the Foundation.
omne vero reliquum vulgus sit in atriis domus Domini.
Yet truly, let all the remainder of the common people be in the courts of the house of the Lord.
Nec quispiam alius ingrediatur domum Domini,
Let no one else enter into the house of the Lord,
and those from the Levites who are ministering.
et omne reliquum vulgus observet custodias Domini.
And let all the remainder of the common people observe the watches of the Lord.
Then let the Levites encircle the king,
habentes singuli arma sua (et siquis alius ingressus fuerit templum,
And if anyone else will have entered into the temple,
And may they be with the king,
juxta omnia quæ præceperat Jojada pontifex:
acted in accord with all that the high priest Jehoiada had instructed.
et assumpserunt singuli viros qui sub se erant,
And each of them took the men who were under him,
and who were arriving by the course of the Sabbath,
with those who had fulfilled the Sabbath and who were about to depart.
For indeed the high priest Jehoiada had not permitted the companies to depart,
siquidem Jojada pontifex non dimiserat abire turmas quæ sibi per singulas hebdomadas succedere consueverant.
which were accustomed to replace one another each week.
gave to the centurions the lances and round shields and crescent shields of king David,
which he had dedicated in the house of the Lord.
Constituitque omnem populum tenentium pugiones a parte templi dextra,
And he positioned all the people,
from the right part of the temple to the left part of the temple,
before the altar and the temple,
And they led out the son of the king.
And they imposed the diadem on him,
dederuntque in manu ejus tenendam legem,
And they gave him the law to hold in his hand.
And they appointed him as king.
the high priest Jehoiada and his sons anointed him.
And when Athaliah had heard it,
vocem scilicet currentium atque laudantium regem,
specifically the sound of running and the praising of the king,
ingressa est ad populum in templum Domini.
she entered to the people in the temple of the Lord.
Cumque vidisset regem stantem super gradum in introitu,
And when she had seen the king standing upon the step at the entrance,
and all the people of the land rejoicing,
and playing on instruments of various kinds,
and the voice of those who were praising,
Egressus autem Jojada pontifex ad centuriones et principes exercitus,
Then the high priest Jehoiada, going out to the centurions and to the leaders of the army,
“Lead her away, beyond the borders of the temple.
And let her be put to death outside, with the sword.”
Præcepitque sacerdos ne occideretur in domo Domini,
And the priest instructed that she should not be killed in the house of the Lord.
And they laid hands on her neck.
cumque intrasset portam equorum domus regis,
And when she had entered the gate for the horses at the king’s house,
they put her to death there.
Pepigit autem Jojada fœdus inter se,
Then Jehoiada formed a covenant between himself
so that they would be the people of the Lord.
Itaque ingressus est omnis populus domum Baal,
And so, all the people entered into the house of Baal,
et altaria ac simulacra illius confregerunt:
And they broke apart his altars and idols. Also,
Mathan quoque sacerdotem Baal interfecerunt ante aras.
they put to death Mattan, the priest of Baal, before the altars.
Constituit autem Jojada præpositos in domo Domini sub manibus sacerdotum et Levitarum quos distribuit David in domo Domini,

Then Jehoiada appointed overseers in the house of the Lord, under the hands of the priests and Levites, whom David had distributed to the house of the Lord so that they might offer holocausts to the Lord,
ut offerrent holocausta Domino, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi,
just as it was written in the law of Moses,
in accord with the disposition of David.
Constituit quoque janitores in portis domus Domini,
Also, he appointed porters at the gates of the house of the Lord,
ut non ingrederetur eam immundus in omni re.
so that whoever was unclean for any reason would not enter.
and the leaders of the people,
and all the common people of the land,
et fecerunt descendere regem de domo Domini,
and they set out to descend to the king, from the house of the Lord,
et introire per medium portæ superioris in domum regis,
and to enter through the middle of the upper gate, to the house of the king.
et collocaverunt eum in solio regali.
And they placed him on the royal throne.
And all the people of the land were rejoicing,
But Athaliah was slain with the sword.
